'''February 2000 Amsterdam tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Vierhoek, Amsterdam, Netherlands on 20 February 2000. [[Koen Meijssen]] won it. It is known from Koen Meijssen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d280">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-23-amsterdam-holland-02-20-00d280/ amsterdam-holland-02-20-00], DeckTech (Koen "Mr. Pink" Meijssen, 23 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-23-amsterdam-holland-02-20-00d280/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Vierhoek, Amsterdam, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Koen Meijssen]]
